caption: The drawing depicts a light brown wooden chest of drawers positioned against a plain, off-white background. The chest has three large horizontal drawers, each fitted with two round dark brown knobs for handles. Above the drawers, there are four rectangular panel sections, with the two center panels featuring a small metallic latch at their meeting point. The construction of the chest displays clean, straight lines, and simple rectangular legs that lift the piece slightly off the ground. The wooden surfaces are rendered with a consistent color, showing some subtle variations in shading to indicate grain and depth. The object is shown in perspective, with the left side and the front face visible. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the drawing.
title: Shaker Chest of Drawers
